camera_routes: Survival and streaming cameras fly at the generator's surface height (bilinear 8-block samples, maximum from 16 blocks behind to 32 ahead, never below sea level) plus the scene's clearance.
entity_fixture: The entity scene holds dawn (time 0.0, below the undead sunburn threshold) with no daylight cycle or natural spawning, so its specified population is not burned or diluted; start and end populations must stay within 5%.
validity: A run counts only with zero paused simulation time (except in the menu scenes, which pause it as Java does), completed ticks within max(2, 0.5%) of 20 per sampled second (except in the menu scenes), zero unpresented (hidden or occluded window) frames, enhanced graphics, an uncapped resolved present mode and any fixed scene population held. Benchmark runs ignore keyboard, pointer, controller and focus input and never save.
limits: Controlled benchmark cameras do not establish ordinary-player acceptance. GPU timestamps are not yet available; device-allocator GPU memory is null where the backend has no allocator report (Metal). Surface frame intervals measure throughput. Additional roadmap biomes, encounters and long-session memory scenes must be added as their implementation passes assessment.
